correctness.rationale: Galanopoulos et al. root-count theorem gives Fredholm index as count of preimages of (s/(s−1+z))^α in Re(z)>0, assumed as a published input. The substitution w=s/(s−1+z) maps this half-plane onto |w−R/2|<R/2 with R=s/(s−1), so polar preimages φ_k=(θ+2πk)/α satisfy |φ_k|<π/2 and r<R^α cos^αφ_k. For 2<α<4 a second branch only near negative ray θ0=π(2−α/2)<|θ|≤π; its radial cap is smaller. Two sector area integral is α R^(2α)∫_(π/α)^(π/2) cos^(2α)u du. At α=3 the trigonometric integral yields (5π−9√3)R^6/32. With ε=α−2 and δ=π ε/(2α), sin(v)~v uniformly near zero yields area/ε^5→π^5 R^4/2560. Independently integrated α=3 (R=1), obtaining 0.0037345624946584647 versus exact 0.0037345624946584777, and checked numeric ratios for ε .03, .01, .003. The finite checks do not prove the operator theorem.
